title: CloudHealthRule
description: A health rule on the Cisco Observability Platform that defines performance thresholds for monitored cloud entities.

id.description: The unique identifier of the health rule.

name.description: The name of the health rule.

description.description: A description of the health rule purpose.

enabled.description: Whether the health rule is currently enabled.

entityType.description: The type of entity this health rule monitors.

entityFilter.description: Filter criteria for selecting which entities are monitored.

conditions.description: The conditions that define violations for this health rule.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the health rule was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the health rule was last updated.
